footer.description: Master your presentations with AI-powered voice control and analytics.

hero.description: Ditch the remote. You speak, AI listens and switches your slides at the perfect moment. Rehearse, get analytics, and dominate the stage.

features.title: Powerful Features for the Stage
features.description: PreCue is equipped with advanced AI tools that transform your presentation experience from start to finish.

voiceControl.title: AI Voice Control
voiceControl.desc: Leave the remote behind. Just speak, and AI understands the context to switch slides for you.

rehearsalAnalytics.title: Rehearsal Analytics
rehearsalAnalytics.desc: Track your speaking pace, duration, and pauses. See all your mistakes before you step on stage.

smartInsights.title: Smart Insights
smartInsights.desc: Upload your presentation and let AI generate summaries, key points, and Q&A sets automatically.

realtimeFeedback.title: Real-time Feedback
realtimeFeedback.desc: Get instant tips on tonality, energy, and flow during rehearsals to sharpen your performance.

archive.title: Presentation Archive
archive.desc: Store all your rehearsals and live presentations in one place, and track your progress over time.

secure.title: Secure & Fast
secure.desc: Your presentations are encrypted end-to-end. Access them instantly from any device, anywhere.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Mastering your stage presence in three simple steps.

step1.title: Upload Your Deck
step1.desc: Import your presentation in PDF or PPTX format in seconds.

step2.title: Train the AI
step2.desc: Set keywords for slide transitions or let the AI decide based on context.

step3.title: Own the Stage
step3.desc: Focus entirely on your storytelling; PreCue handles the rest seamlessly.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Leading Speakers
testimonials.subtitle: Join the professionals who have transformed their presentation style with PreCue.

sarah.content: PreCue changed the way I present. No more awkward fumbling for the remote. It's like having a silent assistant on stage with me.

marcus.content: The rehearsal analytics are a game-changer. Being able to track my pace and filler words helped me land my biggest contract yet.

elena.content: I used to be terrified of stage fright. PreCue handles the technical side flawlessly, so I can just focus on my data and storytelling.
